newsitem.title: USA: Travelers files shelf offering for $1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Travelers files shelf offering for $1 bln.

text.p: Travelers Group Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $1 billion in preferred shares, depositary shares and junior subordinated debt securities.

The preferred shares will be issued by special units of the financial and insurance services holding company. The units will in turn purchase the debt securities from Travelers Group Inc, according to the shelf offering.

Travelers will use the proceeds from the sale of the debt securities for general corporate purposes, which may include capital investments in its subsidiaries. No underwriters were named in the filing.
